title: Resolved relative comparison before chain tensor pullback
statement: Assume derived categories on schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Given a cartesian square f:X to S, f-prime:X-prime to S-prime, g:S-prime to S, g-prime:X-prime to X, coefficient objects K,K-prime and phi:Lg-prime-star K to K-prime [def-pc-derived-pullback], and a covering pair U,V, use the pinned relative arrows [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let G be underived module direct image for g, F its complex functor and eta its localization comparison [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. There are complexes A,B on S and A-prime,B-prime on S-prime, arrows t,t-prime, alpha:A to F(A-prime), beta:B to F(B-prime) and a specified homotopy H:t beta homotopic to alpha F(t-prime). Six isomorphisms identify Lg-star Q(A), Lg-star Q(B), Lg-star Q(Cone(t)) and Q(A-prime),Q(B-prime),Q(Cone(t-prime)) with the global, biproduct-of-local and overlap vertices. After composition with these isomorphisms, the derived adjoint transposes of Q(alpha) eta, Q(beta) eta and Q(Cone.mapOfHomotopy(H) followed by the inverse cone/G comparison) eta are respectively the global arrow, biproduct of the U,V arrows, and overlap arrow. No source complex on S-prime, strict square, or chain tensor pullback is asserted.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-unbounded-mayer-vietoris), 08HZ (lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris), 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open) and 08HY (remark-base-change); resolved relative row comparison, before the cone-to-quotient passage. Official tag pages read 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Obtain the two short exact rows, their strict map into underived g_* of the target row, six vertex isomorphisms and three quotient-component mate equations from relativeMV_direct_image_rows.

The Mathlib cone-to-quotient quasi-isomorphism descShortComplex identifies Cone(P.f) with P.X3 and Cone(P-prime.f) with P-prime.X3. Apply Lg* only to the localized source isomorphism. Take alpha=m.tau1, beta=m.tau2 and H=Homotopy.ofEq(m.comm12.symm). The first and middle equations are exactly those of the row lemma.

The proved private cone_quotient_naturality combines map_descShortComplex with mapHomologicalComplexIso_hom_descShortComplex: the cone map followed by the inverse additive cone comparison and F(descShortComplex P-prime) equals descShortComplex P followed by m.tau3. Naturality of eta transports this identity through localization. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm and homEquiv_naturality_left_symm give the corresponding mate equality (private cone_mate_quotient). Compose it with the target overlap isomorphism and use the row quotient equation. This proves precisely the required overlap identity, without any assertion that g_* preserves quasi-isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Resolved rows isolated in lem-pc-relative-mv-direct-image-rows. Cone/quotient naturality, additive cone comparison, localization naturality and adjunction mate transport formalized by V3, 2026-10-14.

from.place: Resolved relative comparison before chain tensor pullback; separates the resolved-row and tensor-pullback steps of the strict chain-square construction.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_direct_image_homotopy_comparison
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F := G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let η := schemeMVDirectImageLocalization g
    let adj := relativeMVAdj g
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (A B : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (A' B' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B')
      (α : A ⟶ F.obj A') (β : B ⟶ F.obj B')
      (H : Homotopy (t ≫ β) (α ≫ F.map t'))
      (e₁ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj A) ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj B) ≅
        (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
      (e₃ : (derivedPullback g).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t)) ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅
        (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ η.app A') ≫ e₁'.hom =
        e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ η.app B') ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (b U).hom (b V).hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso t' G).inv) ≫
              η.app (CochainComplex.mappingCone t')) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
